uutiset.t: ING Sees ‘Full Unwind’ in Emerging-Market Currencies Underway
uutiset.s: Emerging-market currencies face mounting pressure from the technology selloff, the risk of shrinking interest rate premiums and the threat of fresh global tariffs, according to strategists at ING Bank.

uutiset.t: Dangote Hires Veteran Oil Trader Jonathan Zarembok From Equinor
uutiset.s: Veteran oil trader Jonathan Zarembok is joining Dangote Group, which has a huge refinery in Nigeria and is expanding elsewhere in Africa, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Deutsche Bank Is Among Biggest S&P 500 Bulls With 9,000 Target
uutiset.s: Deutsche Bank AG’s Binky Chadha is among the most bullish stock forecasters on Wall Street, predicting the S&P 500 will recover from its rout to rally 25% by the end of next year.

uutiset.t: Aareal Bank Nears Commercial Real Estate SRT With 12% Premium
uutiset.s: Aareal Bank AG is set to pay investors a premium of more than 12% to hedge part of the risk on a commercial real estate lending book worth around €2.5 billion ($2.7 billion) in only its second such deal.

uutiset.t: Why Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia Matters for China
uutiset.s: After a week of whiplash over Jensen Huang’s future and new US chip curbs, Beijing sent a clear message to Washington about their trade truce: China is holding up its side of the bargain — for now. Nectar Gan explains why China may be playing the long game. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: China’s Surprise Soyoil Export Boom Cools as India Turns to Palm
uutiset.s: India’s appetite for Chinese soybean oil is fading as palm oil becomes more competitive, putting the brakes on Beijing’s surprise emergence as a major exporter.

uutiset.t: India Extends Duty-Free Sugar Imports as Dry Weather Hits Crop
uutiset.s: India has extended the deadline for duty-free imports of raw sugar by three months as El Niño-induced dry weather curbs production in the world’s largest sugar-consuming nation.

uutiset.t: Asia Finds a Surprise Currency Haven in AI-Defying Rupee
uutiset.s: The Indian rupee is Asia’s top-performing currency this month, joining a rally in the nation’s equities as investors double down on a hedge against the artificial-intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Malaysia's AI Ambitions Tested as US Chip Curbs Threaten Data Center Boom
uutiset.s: Insight with Haslinda Amin, a daily news program featuring in-depth, high-profile interviews and analysis to give viewers the complete picture on the stories that matter. The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.s: Allen Career Institute Pvt., an education services company backed by James Murdoch and former Walt Disney Co. executive Uday Shankar, has picked banks for an initial public offering that could raise as much as $300 million, according to people familiar with the matter, adding to a busy pipeline of I

uutiset.t: CATL Tumbles 12% on Fears Over Weak Earnings, Forced Selling
uutiset.s: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd. shares plunged as concerns grew over its earnings outlook and signs emerged of forced selling by leveraged investors.

uutiset.t: UK Heating Bills Surge 26%, Adding to Inflation Pressure
uutiset.s: UK regulator lifts energy price cap by 26%

uutiset.t: AUD/USD: Aussie Set for Biggest Monthly Drop in Four Years as Stocks Fall
uutiset.s: The Australian dollar is poised for its biggest monthly slide in more than 13 years as it extended losses on Wednesday, with the weakness in global stocks damping demand for currencies linked to growth.

uutiset.t: EasyJet Profit Hit By Iran War as Apollo Takeover Looms
uutiset.s: EasyJet Plc said the fallout from Middle East war eroded most of its profit in the fiscal year, with soaring fuel prices hitting the budget carrier as it prepares to be taken over by a US private equity firm early next year.
